high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from zdnet.com, dated 10:22 AM. The content discusses the gaming performance improvements promised by Intel's new Xe3 GPU architecture within its Panther Lake series. The text highlights that compared to the older Xe2 design, the Xe3 boasts 25% more threads, upgraded 12-bit vector engines, and an enhanced ray tracing unit for realistic lighting. A quote from Intel Fellow Tom Peterson is included, stating, "These micro-architectural improvements translate into real-world performance." This is followed by a mention of the improved A18 process technology
